remarks: Discover this move-in-ready 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home perfectly situated in Stamford's desirable Springdale neighborhood. The spacious open floor plan offers effortless flow between the living room, dining area, kitchen, and sunroom-ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. A convenient mudroom makes it easy to kick off your shoes as you come in from the cold, while thoughtful storage throughout keeps everything neatly organized. Enjoy the comfort of two dedicated garage spaces (at additional price) and a quiet setting that still offers quick access to local shops, dining, the train, and both major highways. Comfort, convenience, and location-this Springdale gem has it all!
